About the contrast feedback

The map uses OKLCH to explore hue, lightness and chroma. It samples a finer grid of opaque sRGB colors. Stripes mark colors below your chosen target. Dots mark positions outside sRGB.

A nearby shade is a close sampled option at the starting hue, ranked by distance in Oklab. Applying it is your choice. Changing the background or target keeps your selected color visible so you can compare.

WCAG text contrast is evaluated on the final hex colors, using the unrounded ratio. Feedback under each sample accounts for its size and weight. Large text starts at 24 CSS pixels, or 18⅔ CSS pixels at a bold weight. The heading uses bold text. Font availability and rendering vary by device.

Thin strokes can appear faint even when a color pair meets its contrast target. Try a stronger weight, a larger size or a higher contrast target, and compare with readers who will use your design.
